newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania completes 96 percent of maize sowing.
newsitem.headline: Romania completes 96 percent of maize sowing.

text.p: Romania has almost completed maize sowing and expects a good crop of around 9.3 million tonnes, close to last year's level, agriculture ministry officials said on Friday.
"Our data show maize sowing was completed on 3.01 million hectares, or 96 percent of the planned 3.14 million ha," ministry director Matei Georgescu told Reuters.
Sowing had been delayed due to heavy rainfall last month, which also disrupted other seasonal work. Romanian farmers had to race to make up delays, taking advantage of a three-week dry period.
Georgescu said ranifall in recent days helped large areas of cropland to build up the necessary water reserves which would enable maize to germinate faster.
"We will witness an explosion of (maize) vegetation. We expect a good maize crop provided the weather stays fine," he said, adding it was too early to give an estimate for the crop.
"I think we will be able to issue an official estimate by June 15, following reports from our experts," he said.
A ministry source said maize production was expected to reach around 9.3 million tonnes this year and exports might be in the region of one million tonnes.
Last year, Romania harvested some 9.4 million tonnes of maize, close to the bumper crop of 9.678 million in 1995, when exports totalled around 1.2 million tonnes.
